title: Work tape position bound
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic machine with $K$ work tapes, let $w$ be a choice word, and suppose the total number of work tape positions visited by $M$ on its initial configuration for input $x$ under $w$ is at most $S$. Then, for each work tape $i$, the absolute value of its head position after the run is at most $S$.
hypotheses_covered: The space used on the specified run is at most $S$
